name: Witness
source:
Witness is a visual novel/murder mystery game in which you question three witnesses about a recent murder. You play as The Detective, analyzing various objects at the crime scene and piecing together exactly what happened that night.

[From [url=http://globalgamejam.org/2014/games/witness]Global Game Jam[/url]]
